recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy 1990s pop group composition featuring four members in streetwear, set against a cosmic blue starburst background with heavy black framing and vibrant orange block typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Complementary contrast between deep blue background and bright orange text elements
Dynamic group posing with varied heights and direct eye contact
Radial symmetry of the background light rays emanating from behind the central figures
Heavy black horizontal bands at top and bottom creating a cinematic letterbox effect
coreInvariants: Radial white light streaks on a blue gradient
Bold orange sans-serif display type with black outlines
Streetwear fashion including leather-sleeved varsity jackets and baggy trousers
Circular graphic call-out sticker in the lower right quadrant

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four figures arranged in a diamond formation, occupying the central 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central white light burst behind the group's heads.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top bold title, move down through the group's faces, and land on the bottom title and circular sticker.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with figures and graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Electric blue and navy (background and shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white (light rays and clothing highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blues and oranges; high value contrast between the black bands and white light effects.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to primary blue, secondary orange, black, and white

letterConstructionRules: Heavy black outer stroke on orange fill
Italicized for the bottom title to imply motion
characterSpecificRedesigns: Hyphen in bottom text is elongated and centered vertically
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in upright and italic variants for consistency.
graphicDevices: Circular 'hype' sticker with black text on orange background
Circular logo icon with stylized 'F' in blue/orange

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed nature of the display text.
Provides the necessary industrial, bold 90s feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group of four diverse people in 90s streetwear (varsity jackets, baggy pants) posing dynamically. The background should be a deep blue cosmic starburst with white radial light rays. Add thick black horizontal bars at the very top and bottom of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place bold, orange, condensed sans-serif text in all-caps within the top and bottom black bars. Add a bright orange circle in the lower right corner containing black sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the text orange with a black outline?
Is the background a blue radial starburst?
Is there a circular orange sticker element?

adjustableVariables: Specific color of the orange (from neon to amber)
Thickness of the black framing bands
mustRedesign: Specific song titles on the sticker

mustAchieve: Dynamic, low-angle or eye-level group posing

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the orange text is legible against the black background.
Check that the starburst center is positioned behind the subjects.
Verify the 'sticker' looks like a separate graphic element overlaid on the photo.
Confirm the bottom text is italicized while the top text is upright.
recipe.reuseFormula: 90s Eurodance Layout = (Radial Blue Starburst + Black Letterbox Frames) + (Bold Orange Condensed Sans-Serif) + (Group in Streetwear) + (Circular Hype Sticker)
